reason: The manually sourced status may now be ready to publish through the local controller.

effect: The controller published June's timed observation alongside the unavailable sensor status, completing the goal without presenting a manual check as a live reading.
reaction: The source and time made the final status more meaningful than a simple open-or-closed display.

mostWorthwhile.text: Publishing the sourced observation was most worthwhile: it brought the local network, manual fallback and honest status together in a concrete result.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial controller power and owner-setup sequence felt straightforward and less engaging than the later status problem.

surprise.text: I expected to attach the disconnected sensor to the door; instead, Moth reported its state as unknown, then distinguished June's observation from a sensor reading.

arbitrary.text: Combining the disconnected sensor with Moth rather than the door was not obvious to me, though the resulting unknown status had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the distinction between local control, mechanical fallback and trustworthy status made me curious how the neighborhood will apply the network at a larger scale.
